# REQ: LANG-2651 LANG-2652 LANG-2653 LANG-2654 # Diet problem set FOOD; param cost {FOOD} > 0; param limit default 100; var Buy {j in FOOD} >= 0, <= limit; /* objective */ minimize Total_Cost: sum {j in FOOD} cost[j] * Buy[j]; subject to Budget: sum {j in FOOD} Buy[j] <= 31; option solver 'cplex'; solve; display Buy;
